root: ^Aerandir: Welcome, foreigner. Not sure elven wares interest you, but it’s all I’ve got for sale.

c-1: ^Aerandir: I do. Under the elven shadows of the trees and the guidance of the moon, at the bridge outside where the forge lies.
^ My weapons are a threat to those who are weak in magic, and they protect our people as well as elven steel can.
^Aerandir: Elven steel is all about patience and smooth strokes. The blade is just a small part of the process—tempering, refining, and adorning are just as important.
^ We take great pride in our craft. Our weapons catch the light in any room, their gleam announcing their presence.
^Aerandir: In the right hands, an elven weapon is both art and deterrent. Its beauty is its warning.
c-2: ^Aerandir: As a child, I was never content to sit still. Sparring with friends, crafting makeshift weapons from tree trunks and branches…
^ I suppose even for an elf, I was unusually eager to shape things, to feel the weight of a blade in my hands.
^Aerandir: That curiosity led me to the forge and the study of elvensmithing. I work mostly at night, when the world is quiet.
^ For a time, my hammering kept the town awake, until I learned a simple charm to soften the clanging into a gentle song of birds.
^Aerandir: Most of what I craft travels down the river with the traders who visit the town. I hope my work serves a noble purpose,
^ though I’ve long since accepted that I cannot control what becomes of it once it leaves my hands.
^Aerandir: For me, it is enough to create with care, to leave something behind that bears thought and skill.

s0: ^Aerandir: I cast my vote for Fenlora as guardian. I may have been influenced by… a certain fondness for her, I won’t hide that.
s1: ^Aerandir: A client once offered me thousands of gold for a broken sword. He wanted a real challenge, something like that.
^I refused, of course. No sum could justify destroying something I’ve poured care into.
s2: ^Aerandir: Elves are a proud folk. We expect a greeting, but if it’s not returned, do not take offense — it’s simply how we are raised.
s3: ^Aerandir: Some here in the village are obsessed with perfection in everything — even the carving of a simple bow. It’s exhausting to watch sometimes.
